rows.name: Construction
rows.point: Builders and trades lose money to fake invoices and payment redirects, and the cause is usually one missing email setting.
rows.problem: Builders pay and get paid by email all day, so a forged invoice or a changed bank detail is a real loss, not an IT detail.
rows.label: MEASURED
rows.note: Business email compromise losses in Australia in 2024, up 66 percent on the year, as reported by the Australian Federal Police. A third party's figure, cited, not ours.

rows.name: Councils
rows.point: Local government buys locally and publishes how, so the first job is finding the door that fits you.
rows.problem: Councils buy through shared panels and their own portals, and the rules differ council to council.
rows.label: MEASURED
rows.note: Share of Cairns Regional Council spend that stayed local in 2025/26, from the council's own State of Procurement report. The council's PDF blocked our fetch, so we read it through a search snippet and mark it as such.

rows.name: Health
rows.point: A clinic holds the most private data a small business can hold, so a calm review of the basics comes first.
rows.problem: Patient records, referrals and billing all travel by email and shared drives.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: The health regulator guidance is qualitative. We have not measured clinics ourselves, so we show no figure.

rows.name: Aged care and disability
rows.point: Providers are expected to show they follow a recognised security standard, and many have never been asked how.
rows.problem: Participant data, rosters and funding claims sit across several systems run by different people.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: The NDIS guidance says auditors increasingly expect providers to follow a recognised standard, without naming one. That is a quoted statement, not a count, so we show no number.

rows.name: Logistics
rows.point: Freight runs on bookings, invoices and bank details sent by email, which is where a forged message does the most harm.
rows.problem: Many parties, many inboxes, payments moving daily.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: We have no sourced number for this sector, so we show none. To fix that we would scan a sample of freight and transport domains and publish the count with the date.

rows.name: Mining and resources
rows.point: Suppliers to resource companies are asked to prove their security before they are paid, and the proof can be prepared early.
rows.problem: Large buyers send supplier questionnaires and the answers need public evidence behind them.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: We have no sourced number for this sector, so we show none. A figure we once held for resource spend in one region could not be reproduced, so we dropped it.

rows.name: Education
rows.point: Schools hold family and child data and are rarely asked how their email is protected.
rows.problem: Small IT teams, many staff accounts, and parents who trust the school's email.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: We have no sourced number for this sector, so we show none. We would scan a sample of school domains and publish the count with the date.

rows.name: Retail
rows.point: A shop's brand is its email and web address, so a lookalike or forged message costs trust as well as money.
rows.problem: Customers are told to trust messages from your name.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: We have no sourced number for this sector, so we show none. We would scan a sample of retail domains and publish the count with the date.

rows.name: Hospitality
rows.point: Bookings, supplier invoices and staff rosters all live in email, and one forged message can redirect a payment.
rows.problem: Busy venues, thin margins, and no one whose job is email security.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: We have no sourced number for this sector, so we show none. We would scan a sample of venue domains and publish the count with the date.

rows.name: Professional services
rows.point: Advisers hold client money and client secrets, so clients quietly judge them on how safely they handle email.
rows.problem: Accountants, lawyers and consultants move sensitive files and payment details every day.
rows.label: UNKNOWN
rows.note: We have no sourced number for this sector, so we show none. We would scan a sample of practice domains and publish the count with the date.
